name: @smileid/sample-apps-expo
description: Workspace root for the UseSmileID Expo sample app and its shared UI package.

pinRationale.@eslint/js: The flat-config base ruleset, matched to the eslint version so the two cannot disagree.
pinRationale.eslint: 9.39.5, not 10: typescript-eslint 8 supports both, and eslint-config-expo is only tested against 9.
pinRationale.eslint-config-expo: Versioned with the Expo SDK; knows the Metro, JSX and React Native globals.
pinRationale.typescript-eslint: Type-aware linting for both packages; pinned with eslint because the pair must agree.
